data.long_meaning: Joni derives from the Hebrew name Yonah, meaning 'dove' or 'God is gracious'. In the Bible, the name Yonah is borne by the prophet Jonah, who was commanded by God to go to the Assyrians and warn them of their impending destruction. The name Joni carries the meaning “God is gracious” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Joni usually hope their child will grow to embody god is gracious and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_english.name: Joni
in_english.meaning: Joni - feminine given name, derived from Hebrew root
in_english.long_meaning: Joni - feminine given name, derived from Hebrew root 'Jon', meaning 'law' or 'order', combined with 'I', meaning 'Lord' or 'fire', resulting in 'Jon', meaning 'wife law' or 'wife fire'. In Christian tradition, Joni signifies 'wife of the law' or 'wife of the fire'.

Joni, as a derivative of this name, carries the same message of God's graciousness and the importance of obedience and faith.
